description_en: Creates a multi-zone cluster by calling CreateMultiZoneCluster
description_zh: 调用CreateMultiZoneCluster可以创建多可用区集群

name: CreateMultiZoneCluster

parameters.help_en: The service type. Currently, only ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition is supported. Set the value to hbaseue
parameters.help_zh: 服务类型，目前仅支持HBase增强版，取值为hbaseue
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The version number of the engine type. Set the value to 2.0
parameters.help_zh: 引擎类型的版本号，取值为2.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The version of the deployment architecture. Currently, only the hbaseue engine type is supported. Set the value to 2.0
parameters.help_zh: 部署架构的版本，目前仅支持hbaseue引擎类型，取值为2.0
parameters.name: arch_version

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. The following rules apply:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.
The name can contain digits or special characters, including periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称，设置规则如下：

长度为2~128个字符。
以大小写字母或中文开头。
可包含数字或者特殊字符，特殊字符包括半角句号（.）、短横线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the instance resides. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). The VPC must be in the region specified by RegionId
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID，必须在RegionId所在的地域下
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The zone combination. You can go to the buy page or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203039.html operation to view the supported zone combinations.</props>
<props="intl">The zone combination. You can go to the buy page to view the supported zone combinations.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">可用区组合。可用区组合支持情况可前往售卖页或者通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203039.html接口查看。</props>
<props="intl">可用区组合。可用区组合支持情况可前往售卖页查看。</props>
parameters.name: multi_zone_combination

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the primary zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 主可用区实例的可用区ID
parameters.name: primary_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the primary zone instance. The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by PrimaryZoneId
parameters.help_zh: 主可用区实例的虚拟交换机ID，必须在PrimaryZoneId对应的可用区下
parameters.name: primary_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the secondary zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区实例的可用区ID
parameters.name: standby_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the secondary zone instance. The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by StandbyZoneId
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区实例的虚拟交换机ID，必须在StandbyZoneId对应的可用区下
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the arbiter zone
parameters.help_zh: 仲裁可用区ID
parameters.name: arbiter_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the arbiter zone. The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by ArbiterZoneId
parameters.help_zh: 仲裁虚拟交换机ID，交换机需位于ArbiterZoneId对应的可用区下
parameters.name: arbiter_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the master node. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html operation to query the node specifications
parameters.help_zh: master节点规格，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html接口查询
parameters.name: master_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the core node. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html operation to query the node specifications
parameters.help_zh: core节点规格，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html接口查询
parameters.name: core_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the core node. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd_pro: throughput-intensive local disk.
local_ssd_pro: I/O-intensive local disk
parameters.help_zh:
core磁盘类型，取值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
local_hdd_pro：吞吐密集型本地盘 。
local_ssd_pro：I/O密集型本地盘
parameters.name: core_disk_type

parameters.help_en: The disk size of the node. Valid values: 400 to 64000. Unit: GB. The value must be a multiple of 40
parameters.help_zh: 节点磁盘大小，范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB
parameters.name: core_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The number of core nodes. Valid values: 2 to 20. The value must be an even number
parameters.help_zh: Core节点个数，Core节点个数取值范围为2~20，且增量为2的倍数
parameters.name: core_node_count

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the log node. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html operation to query the node specifications
parameters.help_zh: log节点规格，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html接口查询
parameters.name: log_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the log node. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd_pro: throughput-intensive local disk.
local_ssd_pro: I/O-intensive local disk
parameters.help_zh:
log节点磁盘类型，取值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
local_hdd_pro：吞吐密集型本地盘 。
local_ssd_pro：I/O密集型本地盘
parameters.name: log_disk_type

parameters.help_en: The disk size of the log node. Valid values: 400 to 64000. Unit: GB. The value must be a multiple of 40
parameters.help_zh: log节点磁盘大小，范围为400~64000 GB，步长为40 GB
parameters.name: log_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The number of log nodes. Valid values: 4 to 400. The value must be a multiple of 4
parameters.help_zh: log节点数量，log节点个数取值范围为4~400，且为4的倍数
parameters.name: log_node_count

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

If the IP address is set to 127.0.0.1, no IP addresses are allowed to access the instance. For example, 192.168.0.0/24 indicates that all IP addresses in the 192.168.0.XX range are allowed to access the instance
parameters.help_zh:
添加实例的白名单IP地址，多个白名单IP地址之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

如果IP地址设置为127.0.0.1，表示禁止所有地址访问该实例。例如IP地址为192.168.0.0/24表示允许所有192.168.0.XX的IP地址访问该实例
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：
Prepaid：预付费。
Postpaid：后付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period for the subscription instance. Valid values:
year: year.
month: month.

This parameter is required only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月实例的购买单位，取值：
year：年。
month：月。

仅当实例的付费类型为Prepaid时，需要填写此参数
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period of the subscription instance. Valid values:

If PeriodUnit is set to year, valid values are 1 to 3.
If PeriodUnit is set to month, valid values are 1 to 9.

This parameter is required only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月实例的购买时长，取值：

当PeriodUnit为year时，取值范围为1~3。
当PeriodUnit为month时，取值范围为1~9。

仅当实例的付费类型为Prepaid时，需要填写此参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The Unified Auto Renewal Cycle. Unit: months.
  • Default value: 0, which indicates that auto-renewal is disabled.
  • If AutoRenewPeriod is set to 2, the instance is automatically renewed for two epochs upon expiration.
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位：月。
  • 默认为0，表示不自动续费。
  • AutoRenewPeriod=2，表示到期后自动续费2个月。
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 保证接口幂等性的token
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can query the resource group ID in the resource group console. If you do not specify this parameter, the instance is added to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，可通过资源组控制台查询，不填时放入默认资源组中
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ClusterId.description_en: The instance ID of the ApsaraDB for HBase multi-zone database instance that is active
ClusterId.description_zh: 云数据库HBase多可用区实例ID
